name: small oily rain puddle on the ground with a rainbow sheen
label: wasteland_ruins/puddle
reasons: 화풍: 칸 정보량이 기준보다 훨씬 낮음 (4/4)

surfaces.part: puddle oval surface with rainbow sheen

answer.evidence: The object is a flat oval puddle. The width profile (7, 11, 13, 15, 15, 15, 13, 11, 7 over rows 5-13) widens then narrows again, which makes an ellipse seen from above. Rows 5-13 are the whole object. It has no vertical front face, no eave, and no edge line. The multicolored pixels (yellow, teal, blue, white) are sheen details inside the surface. This is a flat ground decal with no front face, which suits the flat kind.

styleAnswer.evidence: The candidate is a tiny dark oval, about 20x12 source pixels, which is smaller than one 16x16 tile. It is not the 4x3-tile ground patch the kind calls for, and the references are full ground surfaces (grass, paving). Measured facts give 0 tones per tile because the piece is under one tile, so I judged by eye. It has only 9 distinct colours and shows about 3 steps: a dark rim, a blue-ish fill and a small highlight. The rim looks like a uniform dark outline, a sticker look, with no visible grain, tufts or per-tone variation, unlike the grass (about 3 visible tones with tufts) and the paving (7 tones with stone-by-stone shading). The rainbow sheen is barely visible. It is not a ground surface patch at all, and it would look thinner, flatter and more sticker-like beside the references.

It has only 9 distinct colours and no full 16x16 tile, so the per-tile facts read 0 and I judged by eye. The dark rim is tinted (0% neutral edge pixels), so the outline is not near-black.
